_source: 2023 NBA CBA, Article VII, Section 2(e) — 'Operation of Apron Levels'
_corpus_lines: corpus/text/2023-nba-cba.raw.txt lines 2736-2835 (table at 2775-2820, worked examples from 2825)
_semantics: The CBA does not frame apron consequences as flat prohibitions. Per Section 2(e)(2)(i): (A) a Team MAY NOT engage in a listed transaction if, immediately after, its 'Apron Team Salary' would EXCEED the listed 'Applicable Apron Level'; and (B) once it engages in that transaction, it is HARD-CAPPED at that Applicable Apron Level for the remainder of the Salary Cap Year. So a team already above the First Apron cannot do rows A-G; a team above the Second Apron cannot do rows A-K.
_apron_team_salary_note: 'Apron Team Salary' (defined Section 2(e)(1), line 2737) is a distinct, higher figure than ordinary Team Salary — it adds back Performance Bonuses, uses higher of qualifying-offer/first-refusal amounts for RFAs, etc. Do not conflate with Team Salary or the Tax Level.

hard_cap_triggers.transaction: Sign or acquire a player using the Bi-annual Exception
Sign or acquire a player using the Non-Taxpayer Mid-Level Salary Exception
Acquire a player under a contract signed-and-traded to you (a Contract entered into per Section 8(e)(1))
Sign, during the Regular Season, a player waived mid-season whose prior Salary exceeded the Non-Taxpayer MLE (i.e. sign a bought-out/waived 'above-MLE' player)
Acquire a player using an Expanded Traded Player Exception
Acquire a player using a Standard Traded Player Exception after the Regular Season in which it arose (i.e. use a carried-over TPE from a prior trade)
Acquire a player using a Transition Traded Player Exception
Acquire a player using an Aggregated Standard Traded Player Exception (combine two or more players' salaries to match for an incoming player)
Pay cash to another Team in connection with a trade
Acquire a player using a TPE that arose from a sign-and-trade (a Contract signed-and-traded per 8(e)(1))
Sign a player using the Taxpayer Mid-Level Salary Exception

additional_rules.offseason_projection: Section 2(e)(2)(ii) (line 2756): in the post-Regular-Season-through-year-end window, rows E-J additionally cannot push the team's PROJECTED Apron Team Salary for the FOLLOWING Salary Cap Year over the corresponding apron (options assumed exercised, etc., per 2(e)(3)).
additional_rules.taxpayer_mle_lockout: Section 2(e)(2)(iii) (line 2759): once a team signs anyone with the Taxpayer MLE, it may not engage in rows A-E (2023-24) / rows A-F (2024-25 onward). So the Taxpayer MLE and the TPE/BAE/NTMLE tools are mutually exclusive within a year.
additional_rules.not_in_this_table: The second-apron FROZEN/MOVABLE first-round-DRAFT-PICK penalty is NOT in this table — it lives in Article VII, Section 2 ('Draft Pick Penalty'). Verify separately.
